metadata.description: All-in-one SEO, link-building and enterprise operations plugin for Claude Code, merging claude-seo and backlink_skills. 46 sub-skills (27 core + 1 orchestrator + 1 framework + 2 extension mirrors + 15 link-building) and 19 sub-agents: audits, technical SEO, content, schema, local, GEO, backlinks, prospecting, directory submission, writing, plus client workspaces, approvals, audit log, exports and portfolio reporting. Includes 9 optional MCP extensions and the optional seo-cockpit companion.
